LU11.basis: WHO: thumb, radial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal-lateral to the radial nail corner, at the radial-border x nail-base crossing. Nail geometry is approximate (nail base set at 30% of the distal phalanx from its joint, from the Gray bone outline); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

LI1.basis: WHO: index finger, radial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal-lateral to the radial nail corner. Nail geometry is approximate (nail base set at 30% of the distal phalanx from its joint, from the Gray bone outline); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

PC9.basis: WHO (main text): centre of the tip of the middle finger (alternative given by WHO: 0.1 f-cun proximal to the radial nail corner - see alt). Skin edge found by ray from the Gray distal phalanx.
PC9.alt_basis: WHO alternative location: 0.1 f-cun proximal to the radial corner of the middle fingernail, Nail geometry is approximate (nail base set at 30% of the distal phalanx from its joint, from the Gray bone outline); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

HT9.basis: WHO: little finger, radial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal-lateral to the radial nail corner. Nail geometry is approximate (nail base set at 30% of the distal phalanx from its joint, from the Gray bone outline); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

SI1.basis: WHO: little finger, ulnar to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal-medial to the ulnar nail corner. Nail geometry is approximate (nail base set at 30% of the distal phalanx from its joint, from the Gray bone outline); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

TB1.basis: WHO: ring finger, ulnar to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal to the ulnar nail corner. Nail geometry is approximate (nail base set at 30% of the distal phalanx from its joint, from the Gray bone outline); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

LI2.basis: WHO: index finger, in the depression distal to the radial side of the 2nd MCP joint, at the red/white flesh border. Placed on the radial border 0.35 cm distal to the metacarpal head (Gray bone outline).

SI2.basis: WHO: little finger, in the depression distal to the ulnar side of the 5th MCP joint, at the red/white flesh border (palmar: ulnar end of the little finger's palmar MCP crease). Placed on the ulnar border 0.35 cm distal to the metacarpal head.

LI3.basis: WHO: dorsum of the hand, in the depression radial and proximal to the 2nd MCP joint. Placed 0.45 cm proximal to the 2nd metacarpal head, on its radial side.

LI4.basis: WHO: dorsum of the hand, radial to the midpoint of the 2nd metacarpal bone. Midpoint of the Gray 2nd metacarpal, moved 0.45 cm radial of the shaft edge.

SI3.basis: WHO: dorsum, in the depression proximal to the ulnar side of the 5th MCP joint, at the red/white flesh border (= ulnar end of the distal transverse palmar crease when slightly flexed). Placed 0.45 cm proximal to the 5th metacarpal head, ulnar side.

TB2.basis: WHO: dorsum of the hand, in the depression superior (proximal) to the web margin between the ring and little fingers, at the red/white flesh border. Placed 0.5 cm proximal to the midpoint between the two proximal-phalanx bases.

TB3.basis: WHO: dorsum, between the 4th and 5th metacarpal bones, in the depression proximal to the 4th MCP joint. Placed in the gap between the Gray 4th and 5th metacarpal shafts, 1.15 cm proximal to the 4th metacarpal head.

PC8.basis: WHO: palm, in the depression between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpal bones, proximal to the MCP joints (alternative: between the 3rd and 4th). Placed midway between the Gray 2nd and 3rd metacarpal shafts, 1.1 cm proximal to the metacarpal heads (where the middle fingertip lands in a fist).

HT8.basis: WHO: palm, in the depression between the 4th and 5th metacarpal bones, proximal to the 5th MCP joint, at the level of PC8 (where the little fingertip rests in a fist). Placed midway between the Gray 4th and 5th metacarpals at PC8's level.

LU10.basis: WHO: palm, radial to the midpoint of the 1st metacarpal bone, at the red/white flesh border. Midpoint of the Gray 1st metacarpal moved radially to 0.55 cm inside the skin edge (the border of the thenar eminence).

LU9.basis: WHO: anterolateral wrist, between the radial styloid process and the radial artery, on the palmar wrist crease radial side. Placed on the wrist-crease line, 0.75 cm ulnar to the radial edge of the Gray radius.

LU8.basis: WHO: 1 B-cun superior to the palmar wrist crease, between the radial styloid and the radial artery (assumed 1 B-cun = 2.1 cm).

LU7.basis: WHO: radial aspect of the forearm, groove of the abductor pollicis longus tendon, 1.5 B-cun superior to the palmar wrist crease (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun); placed 0.55 cm inside the radial edge.

PC7.basis: WHO: midpoint of the palmar wrist crease, between the palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis tendons. Placed at the centre of the Gray wrist crease.

PC6.basis: WHO: 2 B-cun proximal to the palmar wrist crease, between palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun).

PC5.basis: WHO: 3 B-cun proximal to the palmar wrist crease, between palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun).

HT7.basis: WHO: wrist, on the palmar wrist crease, radial to the flexor carpi ulnaris tendon, in the depression radial to the proximal border of the pisiform. Placed on the crease line 0.35 cm radial of the Gray pisiform.

HT6.basis: WHO: 0.5 B-cun proximal to the palmar wrist crease (= 0.5 B-cun proximal to HT7), radial to the flexor carpi ulnaris tendon (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun).

HT5.basis: WHO: 1 B-cun proximal to the palmar wrist crease (= 1 B-cun proximal to HT7), radial to the flexor carpi ulnaris tendon (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun).

HT4.basis: WHO: 1.5 B-cun proximal to the palmar wrist crease (= 1.5 B-cun proximal to HT7), radial to the flexor carpi ulnaris tendon (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun).

LI5.basis: WHO: posterolateral wrist, radial side of the dorsal wrist crease, distal to the radial styloid process, in the anatomical snuffbox. Placed at the assumed dorsal-crease level (y=0.5 cm above the palmar crease), at the radial edge of the Gray radius.

SI5.basis: WHO: posteromedial wrist, in the depression between the triquetrum and the ulnar styloid process. x = midpoint of the shortest line between the Gray triquetrum and ulna; level set to the assumed dorsal wrist crease.

SI4.basis: WHO: posteromedial wrist, in the depression between the base of the 5th metacarpal and the triquetrum, at the red/white flesh border. Placed at the Gray 5th-metacarpal base, ulnar side.

SI6.basis: WHO: posteromedial forearm, in the depression radial to the head of the ulna, 1 B-cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun).

TB4.basis: WHO: posterior wrist, on the dorsal wrist crease, ulnar to the extensor digitorum tendon, in line with the gap between the 4th and 5th metacarpals, at the same level as LI5 and SI5. Placed on that line at LI5's level.

TB5.basis: WHO: posterior forearm, midpoint of the interosseous space between radius and ulna, 2 B-cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun).

TB6.basis: WHO: 3 B-cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, midpoint of the interosseous space (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun).

LI6.basis: WHO: posterolateral forearm, on the LI5-LI11 line, 3 B-cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease (assumed 2.1 cm per B-cun); radial edge placement approximate.

lines.name: Life line
lines.note: Drawn along the thenar crease, curving round the base of the thumb (Venus). Traditionally: vitality and major life changes.

lines.name: Head line
lines.note: Drawn along the proximal transverse palmar crease. Traditionally: intellect and approach to thinking.

lines.name: Heart line
lines.note: Drawn along the distal transverse palmar crease. Traditionally: emotional life and relationships.

lines.name: Fate line (Saturn)
lines.note: Conventional placement: from the wrist towards the middle finger. Traditionally: career and life direction; often absent. Not a skin crease.

lines.name: Sun line (Apollo)
lines.note: Conventional placement: towards the ring finger. Traditionally: recognition and creativity. Often absent. Not a skin crease.

lines.name: Mercury line (health)
lines.note: Conventional placement: from the wrist area towards the little finger. Traditionally: health and communication. Often absent. Not a skin crease.

mounts.name: Mount of Jupiter
mounts.note: Pad under the index finger. Traditionally: ambition, leadership.

mounts.name: Mount of Saturn
mounts.note: Pad under the middle finger. Traditionally: responsibility, discipline.

mounts.name: Mount of Apollo (Sun)
mounts.note: Pad under the ring finger. Traditionally: creativity, recognition.

mounts.name: Mount of Mercury
mounts.note: Pad under the little finger. Traditionally: communication, commerce.

mounts.name: Mount of Venus
mounts.note: Thenar eminence at the base of the thumb. Traditionally: vitality, passion, family warmth.

mounts.name: Mount of Luna (Moon)
mounts.note: Hypothenar eminence on the ulnar edge of the palm above the wrist. Traditionally: imagination, intuition.

mounts.name: Mount of Mars (upper / positive)
mounts.note: Radial palm between Jupiter and Venus, inside the life line start (conventions differ). Traditionally: courage, resilience.

mounts.name: Mount of Mars (lower / negative)
mounts.note: Ulnar palm between Mercury and Luna, between the ends of the heart and head lines (conventions differ). Traditionally: self-control, resistance.

fingers.label: Thumb · will & logic
fingers.note: Often tied to will and logic; some schools link it to Venus (base) and Mars.

palmistry.note: Palmistry is a traditional reading, not science. Heart, head and life lines are laid over the distal transverse, proximal transverse and thenar skin creases of the Gray reference; fate, sun and mercury lines and every mount position are conventional drawings.

_note: Skin outline, bones and crease lines are traced from the public-domain Gray fig. 1237 vector; absolute size assumes wrist-crease-to-middle-fingertip = 18.7 cm. Point positions are approximate placements from WHO 2008 wording (see each basis).
